_comment: ADR-096 class policy — the router-owned half of model routing (the per-stack candidate CHAINS stay in agents/stacks.json / AgentStack claims; launchers pass them to POST /route, the router filters against THIS file + strikes + capacity). Lives in the kustomize dir because kustomize configMapGenerator cannot load outside its root; consumers use the API, never this file directly. tier_thresholds = FU-109 (dispatch units defer later than heavy sessions). model_tiers must cover every stacks.json chain entry (CI: devbox run router-self-test + agents-registration-lint). rotation_fallback IS the FU-095 rotation v1 — no rankings API exists (probed 2026-07-27), so the list is git-curated, fed by the weekly scout digest; entries are chain-TAIL candidates only, graduation into heads stays human.

selection._comment: The /route ordering rule (operator 2026-07-27, built in P3): among same-class/same-tier candidates the EFFECTIVE-cheapest wins, with a small randomization — a uniform pick among candidates within jitter_band_pct of the cheapest — so evidence keeps accruing across near-priced models instead of a monoculture. Price basis order (ADR-096 addendum 2): MARKET effective price (frontend stats/effective-pricing — 30d traffic-weighted, real cache rates; same basis the pins use) → harvested /generation billed costs as the cross-check → registry list-blend as cold-start fallback.
